english.app[content][about]: [h2][b]THE FORTRESS UNDER SIEGE[/b][/h2][p]Hold the front line against relentless enemy hordes threatening to breach your gates with siege weapons and boulder hurling trolls.[/p][p][/p][h2][b]COMBAT YOUR WAY[/b][/h2][p]Agile ranger with sword and bow? Mounted knight to trample your foes? Raging berserker bathing in a bloody bladestorm? Mix and match to become your own custom flavor of destruction.[/p][p][/p][h2][b]UNIQUE WEAPON ABILITIES[/b][/h2][p]Each weapon comes with its own set of upgrades and abilities, making each run equally fresh and rewarding.[/p][p][/p][h2][b]ELEMENTAL BUILDCRAFTING[/b][/h2][p]Choose game-changing boons each run to infuse your weapons with Fire, Ice, and Lightning. Combine synergies to create devastating chain reactions and melt entire waves in seconds.[/p][p][/p][h2][b]AUTOMATED DEFENSES & TRAPS[/b][/h2][p]Fortify your stronghold with deadly stationary defenses. Deploy boiling oil, ballistas, and spiked barricades to shred invading hordes while you hunt down high-threat commanders.[/p][p][/p][h2][b]CHALLENGING BOSSES[/b][/h2][p]Kill enough enemies to lure out one of the Warlords who will put your skills to the test with special attacks and abilities.[/p][p][/p][h2][b]ENDLESS PROGRESSION[/b][/h2][p]Harvest resources from fallen hordes to unlock permanent character attributes, stronger defensive armaments, and new starting gear back at the stronghold.[/p]
english.app[content][short_description]: Demolish monstrous hordes on horseback or foot, unleash devastating abilities, build the ultimate hero, and protect your fortress with deadly automated defenses in this fast-paced action roguelite.
